### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Compresses an existing skill to its load-bearing core — cutting instruction creep (description enumerations, restated rules, narrative padding) while preserving every behavioral directive. Use when a skill exceeds the authoring budgets (description >400 chars, body past the 700-word target), when touching a skill under the retrofit-on-edit policy, or when a review flags bloat.
